item.title: Latest flare-up between US and Iran bring conflict's lull to an end
item.description: Iran's foreign minister has accused Israel's Benjamin Netanyahu of tricking the United States into war with the Islamic Republic. Over six months into the conflict, there appears to be no end in sight. This after the US struck sites in Iran, prompting Tehran to respond. An April ceasefire brought an end to intense fighting, but sporadic attacks have continued over the Strait of Hormuz. item.title: Netanyahu's wife shares conspiracy claim that opposition leader knew of Oct 7 attacks in advance
item.description: As Israel prepares for what are expected to be close-fought parliamentary elections in October, Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu's wife Sara on Monday shared a conspiracy theory that centre-left opposition figure Yair Golan had advance warning of the Hamas-led October 7, 2023 attacks.

item.title: ישראל תופסת את מפקד חמאס בתקיפה בעזה, אמר שר הביטחון
item.description: ישראל כץ אומר שכוחות צה"ל תפסו את ראש הביטחון של חמאס מועין אל-ערביד במהלך פשיטה עמוקה בעזה, עם תקיפות אוויריות שכיסו את הנסיגה.

item.title: US military striking targets in Iran after attempted attacks on shipping
item.description: Iranian state media reported Wednesday that US strikes killed 11 people in two separate attacks, including four at a wedding in the country’s south. Iran’s Revolutionary Guards said they have responded by attacking US assets in Kuwait, Bahrain, Jordan and Erbil in Iraqi Kurdistan. Follow our liveblog for the latest developments.

item.title: Raising the Altalena: Netanyahu digs up sunken 1948 arms ship in ‘pre-election stunt’
item.description: A ship carrying arms for a right-wing militia, the Altalena was sunk 78 years ago off the coast of Tel Aviv at the orders of Israel’s founders. The discovery of its wreckage last week has given the country’s right-wing government ammunition to target the left and attempt to redirect the campaign for legislative elections in October.

item.title: Netanyahu condemns violence in West Bank
item.description: It was a rare condemnation from what is widely seen as the most religious and ultranationalist government in Israel’s history. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu condemned recent attacks by Israeli settlers on Palestinians in the occupied West Bank, but described the violence as the actions of a “handful of rioters.” Tensions have surged across the territory, with activists accusing settlers of acting with impunity. Much of the recent violence has taken place in the town of Qusra. Peter O’Brien

item.title: נתניהו מגנה את 'מעשי האלימות הפליליים' של מתנחלים בכפרי הגדה המערבית
item.description: ראש ממשלת ישראל בנימין נתניהו גינה בשבת את מה שכינה "מעשי אלימות פליליים" שבוצעו על ידי מתנחלים ישראלים בשני כפרים פלסטינים. מוקדם יותר באוגוסט, קבוצת מתנחלים חסמה את כניסת האספקה ​​לבתים פלסטינים בפאתי קוסרה ותקפו משפחה פלסטינית וצוות תקשורת זר בג'אלוד הסמוכה.

item.title: מבצע ישראלי בעזה הורג 4, אומרים גורמים פלסטינים
item.description: שר הביטחון של ישראל אמר כי המבצע הביא ללכידתו של בכיר חמאס. חמאס אמר כי ישראל שלחה פעילים חשאיים לתוך העיר עזה.

item.title: US launches more strikes on Iran as state media reports explosions
item.description: The Iranian Red Crescent says a child was among those killed when shrapnel from a US strike hit a home. The US military says it is aware of the reports and it never targets civilians.

item.title: Relentless heat worsens Gaza's ongoing struggle to access water
item.description: In Gaza, securing drinking water is a relentless daily struggle. The war with Israel has destroyed critical water and sanitation infrastructure, and as temperatures soar, the extreme heat is escalating an already severe shortage into a deadly humanitarian crisis. Two and a half years of war with Israel have damaged or destroyed nearly 90% of Gaza’s water and sanitation infrastructure according to UNICEF.
